newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCK VOLUME SLIPS ON A NERVOUS MARKET.
newsitem.headline: STOCK VOLUME SLIPS ON A NERVOUS MARKET.

text.p: Most Latvian bluechip prices fell for the third consecutive day on Thursday in trade made nervous by dividend uncertainties ahead of shareholder meetings for major stocks, dealers said.
Total market turnover slipped slightly to 167,000 lats from 170,000 lats. Commercial bank bourse indices fell.
Rietumu Bank's Rietumu closed 1.1 percent lower to 226,42 points and Saules Bank's Saule10 bluechip index fell 0.47 percent to 198,29.
"Uncertainties over dividend payments is one of the reasons behind the nervous sentiment during last few days," Zigmunds Pavlovskis, a dealer of Baltijas Tranzitu Bank said.
Unibanka, the usual market leader, fell five santimes to 4.90 lats while turning over 41,600 lats worth of shares.
Fellow official list stock Staburadze confectionery continued down to 2.85 from 2.90 lats.
Daugavpils Chain factory on the secondary list was among the few that gained ground. It jumped 10 santimes to 2.80 lats on turnover of 64,000 lats, the highest on the bourse on Thursday.
Lode Brick edged up a notch by adding one santime to 2.30 lats as it traded 3,100 lats worth of shares.
Valmiera Fiberglass maker fell ten santimes to 2.10 lats as it saw shares worth 32,200 lats change hands.
Kaija Fish cannery remained stable at 2.30 lats and traded shares worth 4,400 lats.
